locked_decisions.state_space_exception: latent state may be updated using newly observed values, but model parameters must not be re-estimated during the test window

A1_objective_exact.sensitivity_definition: mean squared L2 norm of input Jacobian over fitting plus chronological-validation samples
A1_objective_exact.coverage_penalty_definition: mean squared log-shortfall of total raw Gaussian firing strength below activation_floor on chronological-validation samples
A1_objective_exact.weight_selection: fixed inherited method constants; no V2 tuning

B2_ridge_policy.scope: single global alpha for the base PC-NFPSO configuration
B2_ridge_policy.selection_metric: median MASE across development forecasting conditions
B2_ridge_policy.tie_break: if numerically equal on the primary selection statistic, choose the larger alpha
B2_ridge_policy.regularized_parameters: all TSK consequent coefficients as implemented in the V2 ridge solve
B2_ridge_policy.final_refit: after antecedent selection, consequents are refitted on the complete pre-test training window using the frozen alpha
B2_ridge_policy.historical_note: 1e-4 was used by the V1 implementation whereas 0.05 was stated in the rejected manuscript; neither receives selection preference in V2

C1_lag_policy.rule: L = min(12, max(5, m)); use m=1 when no known seasonal period exists
C1_lag_policy.season_period_source: dataset metadata or synthetic-generator specification fixed independently of forecast outcomes
C1_lag_policy.one_step_feature_availability: x_t may contain only observations y_(t-L) through y_(t-1) available before forecast origin t
C1_lag_policy.lag_based_baseline_policy: SVR, XGBoost, and any other supervised lag-feature baseline use the same L assigned to that series
C1_lag_policy.state_space_policy: ARIMA, ETS, and Theta are not forced into the supervised lag matrix; any seasonal period they use must come from frozen metadata, not final-test outcomes

D1_pso_numerical_specification.optimized_parameters: TSK Gaussian antecedent centers and positive widths only
D1_pso_numerical_specification.particle_initialization: particle 0 is the clipped subtractive-clustering antecedent vector; remaining particles are uniform random draws within bounds
D1_pso_numerical_specification.rng: numpy.random.default_rng with a pre-specified run seed
D1_pso_numerical_specification.random_vectors: independent r1 and r2 vectors per particle update and parameter dimension
D1_pso_numerical_specification.update_semantics: sequential particle updates; global best can change within an iteration
D1_pso_numerical_specification.nonfinite_later_cost: replace by maximum finite floating-point value
D1_pso_numerical_specification.boundary_handling: if proposed coordinate is outside bounds, reverse that velocity component and clip/project the proposed coordinate to the bound
D1_pso_numerical_specification.termination: exactly 40 iterations; no performance-based early stopping
D1_pso_numerical_specification.seed_allocation: to be frozen separately under the development/final seed protocol

E1_synthetic_seed_firewall.final_outcomes_access: prohibited until full Gate-2 protocol commit and tag

F1_custom_synthetic_dgps.reason_zero_noise_not_replicated: deterministic clean generators such as nonlinear_sine and noisy_seasonal would otherwise create duplicated zero-noise series across different seeds

F2_canonical_synthetic_suite.terminology: canonical nonlinear/chaotic benchmark processes; not claimed to constitute one established benchmark collection

G1_real_series_selection_policy.selection_method: deterministic SHA-256 ranking after model-independent eligibility screening
G1_real_series_selection_policy.yemen_tax_role: legacy external descriptive case only; excluded from confirmatory inference

H0_sc_radius_policy.selection_metric: median MASE after aggregation of optimizer replicates within each development condition
H0_sc_radius_policy.scope: one global radius for the base PC-NFPSO model
H0_sc_radius_policy.tie_break: if numerically tied on the selection statistic, choose the larger radius
H0_sc_radius_policy.historical_note: The candidate grid matches the V1 sensitivity grid, but V2 selection is performed exclusively on disjoint development conditions.

H1_baseline_protocol.supervised_tuner: chronological inner-validation within pre-test training only
H1_baseline_protocol.statistical_model_selection: frozen AICc rule within pre-test training

I1_primary_metric_estimand.primary_ci: 95% nonparametric order-statistic CI for median paired difference
I1_primary_metric_estimand.synthetic_final_unit: process x DGP seed after median optimizer aggregation and mean confirmatory-noise aggregation

J1_complete_statistical_analysis_plan.synthetic_analysis_unit: process x DGP seed after optimizer and noise aggregation

feature_policy.engineered_summary_features: not part of the base PC-NFPSO unless explicitly evaluated as a separate variant or ablation

final_test_rules.bug_discovered_after_opening_final: document the bug, invalidate affected final evaluation, fix on development, and use a new untouched final set

gate_2_rule: No V2 forecasting outcome was generated before this protocol freeze
